QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] Key to the Rose Garden
QuestInfo.0: The Lion King doesn't seem to believe that Queen #p2161001# has become a ghost. Could that be why he doesn't hear #p2161001#'s voice? What else is there to do? Go back to the #bQueen#k and ask for her advice.
QuestInfo.1: When you tell the Queen how the Lion King reacted, she suggests that he may believe she's a ghost if you bring him a memory that only he and the Queen know. She says to look in the rose garden, which the King made for the Queen. Defeat the #r#o8210004##k and find the key.
QuestInfo.2: As soon as she sees the #t4032836#, the Queen becomes very happy. She says she was selling flowers at the market when she met the Lion King, who had secretly escaped the castle. Their love began that day, which led to marriage. Based on the Queen's story, the Lion King seems like a hopeless romantic.

0.1: Well, I'm glad that he still remembers me. As long as I haven't been forgotten, I can find a way to make him believe that I'm still here. Can you help me again?

yes.0: He'll believe that I'm still here if you show him a memory that only he and I know. Let's see... Oh, how about this?
yes.1: When I was alive, Leon had a rose garden made for me. There, you'll find a #breminder of our memory#k... If you find it and show it to him, he'll believe you.
yes.2: First, you must find the #t4032836#. I remember seeing the #o8210004#s swallow it a long time ago. Please defeat the #r#o8210004#s#k and find the #b#t4032836##k.

no.0: This is the only thing I can do to change his cold heart. Consider my plea.

1.0: You've brought the #t4032836#! Thank you so much. I thought it might have worn away since it's so old, but it's still here! Hee hee hee... Did you know I was a commoner? It would have been impossible for me to marry the king if we had met under normal circumstances.
1.1: One day, long ago, there was a festival. He disguised himself as a commoner and left the castle. At the time, I was selling flowers at the market. When I saw him, I mentioned how strange he seemed for not having a single flower on him during the festival.
1.2: Flowers brought us together, and we eventually married. For us, flowers always played an important role. He gave me a snow rose when he proposed, and gave me a rose garden.
1.3: I can't believe my Leon, who was so romantic and kind, has changed like this. We swore eternal love to each other, and promised that we'd always be together no matter what.

yes.0: I'm sorry. I lost myself for a moment. I'll bring the memento from the rose garden. Please wait a moment.

item.0: I remember seeing the #o8210004# swallow it a long time ago. Please defeat the #r#o8210004##k and find the #b#t4032836##k.
